label: Crouch
description: Duck under obstacles and crawl through tight spaces

parameters.label: Crouch move speed (px/frame)
parameters.help: Horizontal movement speed while crouching. 0 = immobile.

parameters.label: Crouch hitbox height (pixels)
parameters.help: Height of player hitbox when crouching.

parameters.label: Slide distance on release (px)
parameters.help: Momentum slide when releasing crouch. 0 = no slide.
